title: [ingest] Bearer-token auth gates writes; null token = auth-off for localhost dev
summary: TOKEN = mcpCore.readToken(); null means auth is OFF (back-compat localhost dev). When set, these require the token (Bearer header, x-orch-token, or ?token=): /mcp, /reset, /overlay/*, /loop/start, /loop/stop, plus any request carrying ?workspace=. Reads stay open.
